rv.q: For those who like full-throated, unapologetically dramatic singing, this is a dream cast for you.
Sometimes it takes a new voice to make you hear old music as if for the first time.
On this evening, the soprano didn’t disappoint and proved to be fearless in her incarnation of Tosca, even if the rest of her company was not quite on her level.

cn.t: Hernández's fearless Met debut as Tosca wins praise for full-throated dramatic singing, though the revival itself shows its age. Critics laud the powerhouse cast but note uneven staging.
